inspection: Native text and corresponding rendered pages checked for selected methods,observation and uncertainty passages. This is not a comprehensive B1-15 audit.

edges.citing_claim: Earlier calibration uses pressure/arrival information and pressure match as a prerequisite for prediction.
edges.primary_locator: Class2015 pp1–3,6; abstract and approaches I/II
edges.finding: Supports pressure/arrival calibration and parameter correlations. ApproachI manually tunes six permeability modifiers; ApproachII includes inverse fitting. No joint ERT assimilation in these inspected methods. Do not infer priority or full absence of geophysical information: geological priors use geophysical data.

edges.citing_claim: Arrival sensors150m below surface have well/completion transport uncertainty.
edges.finding: Explicitly places GMS150m below ground and describes annulus accumulation,filter crossing and upward travel. Arrival at the well must precede detection; uncertainties of several days motivate greater pressure weight. Does not quantify this study's actual delay or validate the3% model threshold.

edges.primary_locator: Class2015 p5,Table3; p6 Table4 for different fitted cases
edges.finding: Same observed21.7/271days confirmed. ECLIPSE predictions18.9/272 or20.3/256days and DuMux case predictions differ from B1-14's21.8/283. They are different models of shared observations,not independent validation or interchangeable outputs.

remaining: B1-15's other pages,figures,equations,citations and model cases remain for its own comprehensive audit. PartI2018 algorithm,raw multi-physical data and the other B1-14 originals remain unverified.
